title: The Princess and the Pea
moral: A heart that says honestly what it feels is the heart of a true princess.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본(docs/READ_MODE.md). text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. src=reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로, trim 은 from 줄의 영어 녹음을 같은 자리에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

lines.text: 옛날에 진짜 공주와 결혼하고 싶은 왕자가 있었어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, there was a prince who wanted to marry a true princess.
segs: Once upon a time, there was a prince who wanted to marry a true princess.

lines.text: 왕자는 커다란 배에 훌쩍 올라탔어요.
lines.en: The prince hopped, hup, onto a great big boat.
segs: The prince hopped, hup, onto a great big boat.

lines.text: 왕자는 배를 타고 온 세상을 돌아다녔어요.
lines.en: The prince sailed all around the world on his boat.
segs: The prince sailed all around the world on his boat.

lines.text: 파도가 출렁출렁, 배는 이 나라 저 나라로 둥실둥실 떠갔어요.
lines.en: The waves went splish, splosh, and the boat bobbed along from land to land.
segs: The waves went splish, splosh, and the boat bobbed along from land to land.

lines.text: 온 세상을 다 가 봤지만, 진짜 공주인지 알 수 없었어요.
lines.en: I went all around the world, but I could never tell if a princess was a true princess.
segs: I went all around the world, but I could never tell if a princess was a true princess.

lines.text: 여행을 마친 왕자는 자기 성으로 돌아왔어요.
lines.en: After his journey, the prince came home to his castle.
segs: After his journey, the prince came home to his castle.

lines.text: 그날 밤, 비가 쏟아지고 천둥이 우르릉!
lines.en: That night, the rain poured down and the thunder went rumble, rumble!
segs: That night, the rain poured down and the thunder went rumble, rumble!

lines.text: 주룩주룩, 쏴아쏴아, 빗줄기가 성문을 두드렸어요.
lines.en: Pitter-patter, whoosh, whoosh! The rain beat against the castle gate.
segs: Pitter-patter, whoosh, whoosh! The rain beat against the castle gate.

lines.text: 누가 성문을 똑똑, 두드려요.
lines.en: Someone was knocking at the castle gate. Knock, knock.
segs: Someone was knocking at the castle gate. Knock, knock.

lines.text: 성문이 끼익 열리고, 왕과 왕비가 등불을 들고 나왔어요.
lines.en: The gate creaked open, creeeak, and the king and queen came out holding a lantern.
segs: The gate creaked open, creeeak, and the king and queen came out holding a lantern.

lines.text: 이 밤에 누구지?
lines.en: Who could it be at this hour?
segs: Who could it be at this hour?

lines.text: 문 앞에는 비에 흠뻑 젖은 아가씨가 서 있었어요. 머리에서 물이 뚝뚝 떨어졌어요.
lines.en: At the gate stood a girl, soaked right through. Water dripped, drip, drip, from her hair.
segs: At the gate stood a girl, soaked right through. Water dripped, drip, drip, from her hair.

lines.text: 비를 맞았지만 괜찮아요. 저는 진짜 공주예요!
lines.en: I got caught in the rain, but I'm all right. I am a true princess!
segs: I got caught in the rain, but I'm all right. I am a true princess!

lines.text: 어서 들어와 몸을 말리렴.
lines.en: Come in, dear, and dry yourself off.
segs: Come in, dear, and dry yourself off.

lines.text: 공주가 성 안으로 들어오자 왕비는 곰곰 생각했어요.
lines.en: As the princess came inside, the queen thought for a moment.
segs: As the princess came inside, the queen thought for a moment.

lines.text: 진짜 공주인지는… 살짝 알아볼까?
lines.en: A true princess, hmm? Let's find out... just a little.
segs: A true princess, hmm? Let's find out... just a little.

lines.text: 왕비님은 손님방에 완두콩 한 알, 베개, 매트리스 한 장을 가져왔어요.
lines.en: The queen brought one pea, a pillow and a mattress into the guest room.
segs: The queen brought one pea, a pillow and a mattress into the guest room.

lines.text: 완두콩은 콩알만큼 조그맣고, 매트리스는 커다랗고 푹신푹신했어요.
lines.en: The pea was tiny, tiny, and the mattress was big and soft and squishy.
segs: The pea was tiny, tiny, and the mattress was big and soft and squishy.

lines.text: 왕비님은 두리번두리번, 아무도 없는지 살폈어요.
lines.en: The queen looked this way and that, peek, peek, to make sure no one was watching.
segs: The queen looked this way and that, peek, peek, to make sure no one was watching.

lines.text: 요 조그만 완두콩 한 알을 침대 판자에 톡. 아무도 못 본 척!
lines.en: This tiny little pea goes on the bed board, tap. Nobody saw a thing!
segs: This tiny little pea goes on the bed board, tap. Nobody saw a thing!

lines.text: 왕비는 손님방 침대 앞에서 준비를 계속했어요.
lines.en: The queen kept getting the bed ready in the guest room.
segs: The queen kept getting the bed ready in the guest room.

lines.text: 완두콩 위에 매트리스를 쌓아 볼까?
lines.from: 완두콩 위에 매트리스를 쌓아 볼까? 몇 장일까요? 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Shall we pile mattresses on top of the pea?
segs: Shall we pile mattresses on top of the pea?

lines.text: 왕비님은 매트리스를 한 장, 또 한 장, 차곡차곡 쌓았어요.
lines.en: The queen piled up the mattresses, one, then another, neat and tidy, stack, stack.
segs: The queen piled up the mattresses, one, then another, neat and tidy, stack, stack.

lines.text: 영차, 영차! 매트리스가 점점 높이높이 올라갔어요.
lines.en: Heave-ho, heave-ho! The mattresses rose higher and higher.
segs: Heave-ho, heave-ho! The mattresses rose higher and higher.

lines.text: 스물! 매트리스가 스무 장이에요.
lines.en: Twenty! That makes twenty mattresses.

lines.text: 이불도 스무 장, 푹신푹신!
lines.en: And twenty feather quilts on top, soft and fluffy!
segs: And twenty feather quilts on top, soft and fluffy!

lines.text: 침대는 성의 지붕만큼 높아져서, 사다리가 필요했어요.
lines.en: The bed was now as tall as the castle roof, so they needed a ladder.
segs: The bed was now as tall as the castle roof, so they needed a ladder.

lines.text: 잠잘 시간이 되자 왕비가 공주를 손님방으로 데려왔어요.
lines.en: At bedtime, the queen brought the princess to the guest room.
segs: At bedtime, the queen brought the princess to the guest room.

lines.text: 완두콩은 맨 아래, 공주님은 맨 위에서 자요.
lines.en: The pea at the very bottom, and the princess at the very top.
segs: The pea at the very bottom, and the princess at the very top.

lines.text: 공주는 사다리를 영차영차, 한 칸 한 칸 올라갔어요.
lines.en: The princess climbed the ladder, heave-ho, one rung at a time.
segs: The princess climbed the ladder, heave-ho, one rung at a time.

lines.text: 와, 높다! 잘 자요.
lines.en: Wow, it's so high! Good night.
segs: Wow, it's so high! Good night.

lines.text: 공주는 높은 침대 위에 혼자 누웠어요.
lines.en: The princess lay alone on top of the tall bed.
segs: The princess lay alone on top of the tall bed.

lines.text: 밤이 깊었는데… 공주는 이리 뒤척, 저리 뒤척.
lines.en: Late into the night... the princess tossed this way, and turned that way.
segs: Late into the night... the princess tossed this way, and turned that way.

lines.text: 뭔가 딱딱한 게 있는 것 같아…
lines.en: I think there's something hard in here...
segs: I think there's something hard in here...

lines.text: 매트리스 스무 장 아래, 완두콩 한 알이 콕콕 배겼어요.
lines.en: Under twenty mattresses, one little pea was poking her, poke, poke.
segs: Under twenty mattresses, one little pea was poking her, poke, poke.

lines.text: 공주는 밤새 뒤척뒤척, 한숨도 자지 못했어요.
lines.en: The princess tossed and turned all night long, and did not sleep a wink.
segs: The princess tossed and turned all night long, and did not sleep a wink.

lines.text: 아침이 되었어요. 공주가 사다리를 내려왔어요.
lines.en: Morning came. The princess climbed down the ladder.
segs: Morning came. The princess climbed down the ladder.

lines.text: 공주의 눈은 게슴츠레, 하품이 하암 나왔어요.
lines.en: The princess's eyes were droopy, and out came a big yawn, yaaawn.
segs: The princess's eyes were droopy, and out came a big yawn, yaaawn.

lines.text: 침대 아래에서 왕비와 왕자가 공주를 기다렸어요.
lines.en: The queen and the prince waited for her beside the bed.
segs: The queen and the prince waited for her beside the bed.

lines.text: 왕비가 공주에게 다정하게 물었어요.
lines.en: The queen gently asked the princess a question.
segs: The queen gently asked the princess a question.

lines.text: 잘 잤니?
lines.en: Did you sleep well?

lines.text: 아니요, 솔직히 한숨도 못 잤어요. 뭔가 딱딱한 게 있어서 몸이 뻐근하고 졸려요.
lines.en: No. To be honest, I didn't sleep a wink. Something hard was in the bed, and now I'm stiff and sleepy.
segs: No. To be honest, I didn't sleep a wink. Something hard was in the bed, and now I'm stiff and sleepy.

lines.text: 공주의 대답을 듣고 왕비가 깜짝 놀랐어요.
lines.en: The queen gasped when she heard the princess’s answer.
segs: The queen gasped when she heard the princess’s answer.

lines.text: 매트리스 스무 장 아래 완두콩을 느끼다니! 진짜 공주로구나!
lines.en: She felt the pea through twenty mattresses! She is a true princess!
segs: She felt the pea through twenty mattresses! She is a true princess!

lines.text: 왕비님은 공주를 꼬옥 안아 주었어요.
lines.en: The queen gave the princess a great big hug, squeeze.
segs: The queen gave the princess a great big hug, squeeze.

lines.text: 왕자는 기뻐서 폴짝폴짝 뛰었어요.
lines.en: The prince was so happy that he jumped for joy, hop, hop!
segs: The prince was so happy that he jumped for joy, hop, hop!

lines.text: 그 뒤, 성 마당에 왕자와 공주가 나란히 섰어요.
lines.en: Later, the prince and princess stood side by side in the castle yard.
segs: Later, the prince and princess stood side by side in the castle yard.

lines.text: 왕자와 공주는 손을 꼭 잡았어요.
lines.en: The prince and the princess held hands tight.
segs: The prince and the princess held hands tight.

lines.text: 진짜 공주님을 드디어 찾았어요!
lines.en: At last, I have found a true princess!
segs: At last, I have found a true princess!

lines.text: 꽃잎이 팔랑팔랑 날리고, 모두 활짝 웃었어요.
lines.en: Petals fluttered down, flit, flit, and everyone smiled wide.
segs: Petals fluttered down, flit, flit, and everyone smiled wide.

lines.text: 완두콩은 박물관에 갔대요.
lines.en: And the pea was sent to a museum.
segs: And the pea was sent to a museum.

lines.text: 유리 상자 속 완두콩이 반짝반짝 빛났어요.
lines.en: Inside the glass case, the pea sparkled, twinkle, twinkle.
segs: Inside the glass case, the pea sparkled, twinkle, twinkle.

lines.text: 안녕!
lines.en: Bye-bye!

lines.text: 느낀 것을 솔직하게 말하는 마음이, 바로 진짜 공주의 마음이랍니다.
lines.en: A heart that says honestly what it feels, that is the heart of a true princess.
segs: A heart that says honestly what it feels, that is the heart of a true princess.
